Hi! My name is Richard, and I am a fourth-year undergraduate studying mathematics at Stanford University. I am interested in the intersection between topology and probability—in particular, how the notion of randomness might offer new perspectives on topology through probabilistic methods. Currently, I am curious about how the rich algebraic machinery associated with topology might serve as a bridge between these seemingly distant branches of mathematics.
